title: Chapter 61: Difficulties Of The Tengu Tribe

Chapter 61: Difficulties Of The Tengu Tribe

The rat tribe has a strange appearance. They have a human body and a human head. They are short and have a strange rat face on their head, which looks even weirder than an animal head.

The rat tribe has a stronger reproductive capacity than the pig tribe, and has a strong ability to adapt to survival. The overall population is larger than that of the pig tribe.

The only rat tribe lord present spoke, attracting everyone's attention.

Wu Qing, Meng and the lords of the four territories all looked at the smug rat tribe lord, and had some bad premonitions.

"Hmph...!"

The rat tribe lord cleared his throat before speaking in his strange tone.

"First of all, I want to make it clear that I represent the great Tengu tribe!"

As soon as he said this, some lords started to discuss.

"It turns out that the rat tribe has long since surrendered to the Tengu tribe! I was wondering how it could develop so quickly!"

"This is a spy lurking in our independent territory! I didn't expect it to get here!"

"What should we do? He saw us joining the alliance!"

"What are you afraid of! Since you have chosen to join the alliance, don't worry about the Tengu tribe! Even the armies of the evil god camp!"

"Even if we don't join the alliance, we won't get the Tengu tribe's favor!"

"We were just about to form an alliance, and he came out to make trouble. It seems that the situation is a bit bad!"

"What should we do?"

"Let's see how the several major territories of the alliance deal with it first!"

"..."

The rat tribe lord saw the performance of these lords, his face full of sarcasm. He believed that an alliance formed by such lords would never succeed.

"Everyone be quiet!"

The rat tribe lord roared with great momentum, stopping everyone's discussion, and he was going to continue talking.

The Tengu tribe still has a strong deterrent power in this area, and those small territory lords who were discussing privately immediately quieted down.

"The great Tengu tribe has given me full authority to negotiate with you!"

"You want to form an alliance to protect yourself, I have no objection, but you have enjoyed the long-term protection provided by the great Tengu tribe, now is the time to take responsibility!"

"The great Tengu tribe has been fighting the army of the evil camp for everyone's safety!"

"As long as you send troops to participate in the battle against the army of the evil camp, the great Tengu tribe will not interfere with the establishment of your alliance!"

"What do you think?"

The Rat Tribe Lord looked in the direction of Meng and Wu Qing. He didn't dare to be presumptuous to a strong man like Meng.

Meng said coldly with a sullen face: "How many soldiers are you going to send? How are you going to interfere with our alliance?"

Seeing Meng's changed face, the Rat Lord was a little scared, but he relied on the Tengu tribe as a big backer, and thought of the consequences of failing to complete the task, he still said: "Your alliance has so many territories joining, just send 100,000 elite soldiers to participate in the war!"

"You rat! I will skin you alive today even if I have to sacrifice my territory!"

After hearing the words of the Rat Lord, Meng was furious and was about to walk towards the Rat Lord, but was caught by Wu Qing, who was sitting at the same table.

Seeing Meng's actions, the Rat Lord was really frightened. He knew Meng's character. If he said such words, he would do such things.

He said he would skin him alive, and he really would skin him alive!

He wanted to escape from here, but he didn't dare to. He was responsible for the Tengu tribe. If he didn't complete the task well, his fate would not be much better than being skinned by Meng.

This is the sadness of the weak.

"This Rat Clan Lord, if you have something to say, you can talk to him nicely. You know the reputation of the Tiger Territory. The backers behind you cannot protect your safety."

"Besides, you are just a pawn responsible for delivering messages. Just pass the message on and don't add to the drama."

Hu Wei stood up and said to the Rat Clan Lord with a smile.

The Rat Clan Lord has changed from being arrogant at the beginning to being trembling with fear now.

He didn't expect that the reputation of the Tengu Clan could not suppress the people here.

"Then, how many troops do you think are more appropriate?"

The Rat Clan Lord first looked at Meng timidly, and then looked at Hu Wei for help.

"Humph! We can only send 5,000 elite soldiers at most!"

Meng also knew the limits. This Rat Clan Lord was not a concern. The key was the Tengu Clan behind him.

If the Tengu Clan really wanted to make trouble, the future development of this alliance would be really difficult.

In any case, the Tengu Clan is now the main force in this area to resist the army of the evil god camp. This is an unchanging fact.

Meng directly cut the number of troops to be sent by twenty times, without any tricks, and emphasized that it was 5,000 elite soldiers.

The Tengu tribe would ask the alliance to send troops to help, which was within the scope of Wu Qing and Meng's prediction, and there were corresponding countermeasures.

They just didn't expect that the Tengu tribe would send such a rat lord to negotiate.

This is the Tengu tribe's deliberate devaluation of the alliance, and Meng was angry for this reason.

"Five thousand is too few. The Tengu tribe has given the minimum number of troops to send. They said that if the requirements are not met, then...then..."

The rat lord now dared not say some things directly, for fear that Meng would directly attack him here.

He also knew in his heart that even if Meng attacked him, as long as he finally agreed to the Tengu tribe's request, nothing would happen.

No one would care whether he was dead or alive.

"What is the bottom line!?"

Meng asked in a deep voice.

"Yes, it's 5... 50,000 elite soldiers...!"

The Rat Clan Lord reported this number, and was somewhat afraid to look at Meng, and could only look at Hu Wei, who was smiling.

"You also know that the most powerful Tiger Lord among us sent out 10,000 elite soldiers, and his territory was empty."

"All the territories added together can't even gather 50,000 elite soldiers."

"Just tell me, if there are no 50,000 elite soldiers, what will be the consequences!"

Hu Wei also put away his smile and said solemnly to the Rat Clan Lord.

Hu Wei's deterrence is still not comparable to Meng. Facing him, the Rat Clan Lord spoke quite smoothly.

"The Tengu Clan means that if they can't send out 50,000 elite soldiers, they will take the initiative to give up this area and move the battlefield of the battle with the main force of the Evil God Camp back."

"This area will be given to the Evil God Camp, allowing the independent territory to face the army of the Evil God Camp alone."

When the Rat Clan Lord said this, many lords turned pale, they knew that the Tengu Clan could do such a thing.

Especially for those territories that did not choose to join the alliance, the Tengu clan took the initiative to give in, leaving them with no way to survive.

"Hmph! What are you afraid of!? Even if the Tengu clan fights with all their strength, they can't win!"

"I'm just saying this now to save face!"

"Even if our alliance faces the army of the evil god camp alone and all die in battle, we will not be cannon fodder for the Tengu clan!"

Meng snorted coldly, showing a very tough attitude, which boosted the morale of many lords who joined the alliance.

"Yeah! There is no way to survive, what is there to be afraid of?!"

This is the voice of most lords. Everyone has thought it through. Since they can't even live, they can only choose to die in a blaze of glory!
